evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Vinicius G. Goecks and Nicholas Waytowich
evidence_items.explanation: The study reports fast planning and useful comparative performance in a militarized game, including human feedback. It also reports higher friendly casualties than the comparison methods; this is neither universal failure nor proof of dependable field performance.

evidence_items.publisher: U.S. Army Acquisition Support Center; Maj. Daniel S. Bader
evidence_items.explanation: The developer reports that an LLM prototype made drafting Army evaluation plans more efficient. This challenges an interpretation that excludes all military usefulness, but supplies neither a reproducible reliability evaluation nor enough architectural detail to settle the stated mechanism.

evidence_items.publisher: DEVCOM Army Research Laboratory Public Affairs Office
evidence_items.explanation: The official account describes an experimental planning platform and further refinement. It does not publish operational success rates or establish the absence of flexible underlying representations.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved evaluation establishes repeatable operational success or failure under the full stated scope and mechanism.
